title: Code that lets a lane run `merge --confirm` on its own marked PR (guard or check change)
why: Found by the text lane (lane lanes-merge-own-pr-text; relayed by the coordinator 11:24 CST Nov 15, its reads not read by triage): MERGE_ROLES is batch-runner only, and the guard and the settings allow list agree. So the owner's 11:12 CST ruling own-lanes-merge-claude-settings-prs does nothing until code changes. This code lane lets a lane run `merge --confirm` on its own PR once it is marked ready and green. Per the consultant's 11:18 CST reading, the lane never marks ready; runner 10 marks (see the ruling). It changes a guard's verdict, so it needs a builder, a reviewer and the round rules; it must not loosen red main, classifier refusals, or other repos. Size unmeasured.
